d:
Narrated by Benedict Cumberbatch, this episode of Super/Natural follows the extraordinary lengths animals go to secure the survival of their bloodlines. In the face of predators, famine, and climate extremes, they’ve evolved mysterious abilities to protect and provide for their young. River turtles join forces to predict the future; amphibians poison their young in the name of love; and a mother elephant introduces her calf to the family while it’s still in the womb.
